alerts.message: Docker container 'vaultwarden-db-migrate' is Exited (0) 2 hours ago

findings.title: Vaultwarden container is in an active restart loop on docker01
findings.conclusion: Vaultwarden on docker01 is confirmed in an active crash-restart loop (restart_count climbed 5->7->9 across checks, near-zero CPU/memory, filesystem namespace cycling). A companion Flyway migration container (vaultwarden-db-migrate, app-container-7d93fd2a83f63840) is exited and is the leading hypothesis for a database-migration-related crash trigger, but this could not be confirmed: pulse_read logs against docker01 failed with NO_AGENT (no command connection available), so no container logs, migration exit code, or recent config/env/image-update change history could be retrieved. docker01 host itself is healthy, ruling out host-level resource exhaustion. No typed action capability is advertised for the finding resource, and the candidate causal resource's capabilities could not be checked within this run's tool/budget limits, so no remediation can be safely proposed. An operator must restore docker01's command/agent connection, pull vaultwarden and vaultwarden-db-migrate logs, check for recent compose/env/admin-token changes and whether an image update was applied, and if a corrupted DB or failed migration is found, restore from the most recent backup rather than repeatedly restarting.
